# LayerZeroOptionsHelper
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/chain-bridge/src/helpers/LayerZeroOptionsHelper.sol)

**Title:**
LayerZeroOptionsHelper

Helper library for standardizing LayerZero options creation

Provides consistent methods for creating options for different LayerZero operations


## Functions
### createMessagingOptions

Creates standard messaging options with appropriate gas limit


```solidity
function createMessagingOptions(
    BridgeTypes.BridgeOptions memory options,
    uint128 minGasLimit
)
    internal
    pure
    returns (bytes memory);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`options`|`BridgeTypes.BridgeOptions`|Bridge options containing gas limit and other parameters|
|`minGasLimit`|`uint128`|Minimum gas limit to enforce (if options gas limit is lower)|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bytes`|Options bytes formatted for LayerZero standard messaging|
